tracesTo: SOW: Commissioner Desk & Weekly Content Publishing

stories.title: Build Drag-and-Drop Rankings Builder Component
stories.goal: implement an interactive drag-and-drop interface for ordering teams in power rankings
stories.benefit: commissioners can intuitively reorder teams without manual input of rank numbers
acceptanceCriteria: Component uses react-beautiful-dnd or @dnd-kit for drag-and-drop functionality
Component displays all league teams in draggable list items with team logos and names
Component provides visual feedback during drag operations with hover states and drop zones
Component updates team order state immediately on drop with smooth animations
Component triggers autosave callback after drag operation completes
Component handles touch interactions for mobile devices with appropriate gestures
Component maintains accessibility with keyboard navigation support for reordering

stories.title: Create Team Commentary Input Fields in Rankings Builder
stories.goal: provide text input fields for per-team commentary alongside each team in rankings
stories.benefit: commissioners can add personalized commentary for each team's ranking
acceptanceCriteria: Component includes textarea or rich text input field for each team position
Input fields support markdown formatting or rich text editing for formatted commentary
Input fields show character count with soft limit warnings and hard limits
Input fields trigger debounced autosave (3 seconds after typing stops)
Input fields display saved state indicator ('Saved', 'Saving...', 'Error')
Input fields expand vertically to accommodate multi-line content without scrolling
Input fields preserve cursor position and selection during autosave operations

stories.title: Build Matchup Selector Dropdown Component
stories.goal: create dropdown selector for choosing featured matchup from weekly schedule
stories.benefit: commissioners can easily select matchup of the week from available games
acceptanceCriteria: Component fetches and displays all matchups for selected week from schedule API
Component shows both teams in each matchup option with logos and names
Component displays current scores if games are in progress or completed
Component highlights currently selected matchup with distinct styling
Component updates form state immediately on selection change
Component provides 'No featured matchup this week' option for skipping
Component uses Shadcn UI Select component for consistent dropdown behavior

stories.title: Create Matchup Hype Text Input Component
stories.goal: provide rich text input for adding hype text to featured matchup
stories.benefit: commissioners can write engaging descriptions for matchup of the week
acceptanceCriteria: Component provides textarea or rich text editor for matchup commentary
Component supports markdown or basic formatting (bold, italic, links)
Component displays live preview of formatted text alongside editor
Component includes character count with recommended length guidance (100-500 chars)
Component triggers autosave callback with debounce (3 seconds after typing stops)
Component shows save status indicator visible to user
Component validates input length and displays error messages for violations

stories.title: Build Structured Winner Prediction Form Component
stories.goal: create form for commissioners to predict winners of each matchup
stories.benefit: commissioners can record predictions that will be graded after stat corrections
acceptanceCriteria: Component displays all matchups for selected week in structured list format
Component provides radio buttons or toggle controls for selecting winner of each matchup
Component shows team logos, names, and current records alongside each matchup
Component calculates and displays total number of predictions made vs total matchups
Component highlights incomplete predictions with visual indicators
Component updates form state immediately on selection with autosave trigger
Component allows commissioners to skip predictions with explicit 'No prediction' option

stories.title: Implement Autosave UI Feedback Component
stories.goal: display real-time autosave status indicators across all desk components
stories.benefit: commissioners have confidence their work is being saved automatically
acceptanceCriteria: Component displays 'All changes saved' with timestamp when save succeeds
Component displays 'Saving...' spinner during active save operations
Component displays 'Error saving changes' with retry button on save failures
Component displays 'Offline - changes queued' when network connection lost
Component shows last successful save timestamp formatted as relative time
Component positions save indicator in consistent, visible location (top-right corner)
Component includes appropriate ARIA live regions for screen reader announcements

stories.title: Create Publish Button Component with Validation
stories.goal: build publish button that validates content and triggers publishing workflow
stories.benefit: commissioners can publish content with confidence that all required fields are complete
acceptanceCriteria: Component displays prominent primary action button labeled 'Publish' or 'Publish Weekly Content'
Component disables button when required content sections are incomplete or invalid
Component shows tooltip or popover explaining why button is disabled when hovered
Component triggers validation function that checks all non-skipped content sections
Component displays confirmation modal before publishing with content summary preview
Component shows loading spinner and disables button during publish operation
Component displays success notification with links to published content on completion

stories.title: Build Skip Content Section Toggle Component
stories.goal: create toggle controls for marking content sections as skipped for the week
stories.benefit: commissioners can skip optional content without being blocked from publishing
acceptanceCriteria: Component displays toggle switch or checkbox for each content section (Rankings, Matchup, Predictions)
Component shows 'Skip This Week' label with explanatory tooltip on toggle
Component applies visual styling to skipped sections (dimmed, collapsed, or hidden content)
Component excludes skipped sections from publish validation requirements
Component updates form state immediately on toggle with autosave trigger
Component displays confirmation modal when toggling skip on sections with existing content
Component allows un-skipping sections to re-enable content creation

stories.title: Create Rankings Order Reset and Undo Component
stories.goal: provide controls for resetting rankings to default order or undoing recent changes
stories.benefit: commissioners can quickly recover from mistakes or start over without manual reordering
acceptanceCriteria: Component displays 'Reset to Default Order' button that restores original team order
Component displays 'Undo' button that reverts last drag-and-drop operation
Component shows confirmation modal before executing reset to prevent accidental data loss
Component maintains undo history stack for multiple levels of undo (at least 10 operations)
Component disables undo button when no history is available
Component triggers autosave after reset or undo operations complete
Component provides keyboard shortcuts for undo (Ctrl+Z / Cmd+Z) functionality

stories.title: Build Preview Mode Component for Draft Content
stories.goal: create preview interface that shows how content will appear when published
stories.benefit: commissioners can verify content appearance before publishing to avoid errors
acceptanceCriteria: Component displays 'Preview' button that switches interface to read-only preview mode
Component renders power rankings, matchup of the week, and predictions in published format
Component shows how feed moments will appear in newsfeed timeline
Component applies all production styling and formatting to preview content
Component displays 'Preview Mode' banner at top of interface with 'Exit Preview' button
Component preserves all draft data when exiting preview mode without saving
Component handles empty or incomplete content gracefully with placeholder messages

stories.title: Create Week Status Indicator Component
stories.goal: display visual indicators showing which weeks have drafts, published content, or no content
stories.benefit: commissioners can quickly see their progress across all weeks at a glance
acceptanceCriteria: Component displays badge or icon for each week in week selector dropdown
Component shows green checkmark icon for weeks with published content
Component shows orange clock icon for weeks with saved drafts
Component shows gray or empty icon for weeks with no content created
Component displays tooltip on hover showing publication date or last edit timestamp
Component updates status indicators immediately after publish or save operations
Component provides visual distinction between partially complete and fully complete drafts

stories.title: Build Mobile-Responsive Desk Layout Component
stories.goal: ensure Commissioner Desk interface adapts properly to mobile and tablet viewports
stories.benefit: commissioners can create content on any device with appropriate touch interactions
acceptanceCriteria: Component uses responsive grid or flexbox layout that adapts to screen sizes
Component stacks content sections vertically on mobile devices (< 768px width)
Component adjusts drag-and-drop interface for touch interactions on mobile
Component enlarges touch targets for buttons and controls to minimum 44x44px
Component collapses or simplifies secondary UI elements on small screens
Component maintains all functionality on mobile without requiring horizontal scrolling
Component uses mobile-optimized modals and dropdowns (full-screen or bottom sheets)
